scope: equal-weight top-k ensemble of the five invariant univariate survivors on folds 3 and 4
feature_order_rule: unique univariate all-gate survivors ordered by descending paired-site AP lower bound

ensemble.normalization: unlabeled empirical-rank inverse-normal transform within each fold x sensor
ensemble.orientation: feature direction learned only from the opposite fold
ensemble.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of the first top-k normalized oriented residuals
ensemble.base: exact float64 current scene score in logit space

target_domain.name: low-prevalence physical-location proxy for the official test-only-site view
target_domain.membership: all rows from physical_location_id groups whose combined folds-3/4 positive rate is <=0.05
target_domain.use: development stress view only; it is not a substitute for the untouched official test-only-site benchmark

invariants: The candidate feature set and order are frozen from the already committed univariate report.
Every feature value came from an adapter that excluded the represented sample's fold.
Unlabeled normalization is computed separately within each fold and sensor.
Each feature direction is learned only from the opposite fold.
Only equal-weight prefixes and the predeclared scalar strengths are searched.
Only point-gate survivors can consume paired-site bootstrap computation.
Both whole-development and low-prevalence paired-site AP lower bounds must be strictly positive.
A development pass can only authorize a separately frozen fold-2 protocol.
Fold 2, fresh data, and exact-paper inputs are never loaded.
